subject: english
stem: A coat drive accepts clean coats through November 20. Leo washed his coat on November 18 and brought it on November 19. Is it accepted?
options: Yes, because every kind of clothing is accepted
Yes, it is clean and arrives before the deadline
No, it was washed too early

optionRationales.reason: Yes, because every kind of clothing is accepted：原文只說 coats，理由擴張。
Yes, it is clean and arrives before the deadline：兩句分別證明 clean 與 deadline 前送達。
No, it was washed too early：沒有最早清洗限制。
No, the drive ended November 18：期限是 November 20。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「相隔句子分別提供的條件合併後得到唯一答案」可推出 Yes, it is clean and arrives before the deadline；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Yes, it is clean and arrives before the deadline 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
